:::{#def-complete-inner-product-space}
#### Complete inner product space

A [real inner product space](linear-algebra-inner-products.qmd#def-inner-product-space) $V$
is **complete**
[@wikipedia_complete_metric_space]
if for every [Cauchy sequence](#def-cauchy-sequence) $(\vx_n)$ in $V$
there is a vector $\vy \in V$ such that for every $\tolout > 0$ there is a [natural number](number-systems.qmd#def-natural-numbers) $N$ with

$$\norm{\vx_n - \vy} < \tolout \quad \text{for every } n \ge N.$$

:::
